ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) across approximately 90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed as discrete focal points creating high local contrast but low global brightness.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black base layer across both lobes. Hundreds of discrete, high-intensity (white/light gray) circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters distributed non-uniformly across the visible ventral area, with specific clusters appearing as geometric rings on the mid-to-lower sections of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated interior angle of approximately 105 degrees; the vertex is sharply defined relative to the surrounding lobe curvature.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge; presents as a series of jagged peaks and valleys (3-12 pixels in depth) that break the continuous linear boundary between the fluke and the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral symmetry with a slight concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning into a broad convex arc toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive presence of circular high-contrast rings (varying from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter) across both lobes; highest density is observed in the medial regions of the fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, high-intensity linear pixel streaks visible on the mid-left lobe and a distinct vertical linear mark on the lower-right lobe near the peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant high-intensity, high-relief pixel clustering on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, exhibiting irregular, textured white-and-beige patterns consistent with significant surface colonization or historical trauma.
